atom:entry.atom:summary:
The Analytics Hierarchy Generator Wizard facilitates the creation of hierarchies using ABAP Core Data Services (CDS). This tool guides users through the entire process, ensuring the accurate definition and creation of related artifacts. The wizard supports the following key components:

  • Hierarchy Directory: A centralized repository for managing and accessing hierarchies.
  • Hierarchy Nodes: The individual elements that constitute the hierarchy structure.
  • Hierarchy Base View: The foundational view that underpins the hierarchy.
  • Hierarchy Definition: The comprehensive structure and rules governing the hierarchy.

    • During the creation process, users can define the hierarchy's structure and customize the naming and properties of the generated artifacts. The wizard ensures a streamlined and efficient workflow while enhancing the consistency of the generated CDS hierarchies.
atom:entry.atom:title: Analytics Complete Hierarchy

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The Hierarchy Definition Generator Wizard simplifies the creation of hierarchy definitions using ABAP Core Data Services (CDS). This tool focuses on deriving potential hierarchy nodes from the referenced master data view and guides users through the definition and creation process of the hierarchy definition.

During the creation process, users can either use the derived hierarchy nodes or refine the hierarchy's structure. The user can also customize naming and properties of the generated artifacts. The wizard ensures a streamlined and efficient workflow while enhancing the consistency of the generated CDS hierarchies.
atom:entry.atom:title: Analytics Hierarchy Definition

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The ABAP SQL consumption model makes it possible to access data from external database systems within the AS ABAP using SQL. The external systems can be other SAP HANA or non-SAP HANA database systems, or a remote AS ABAP. A consumption model is defined via the CDS external entities.

This generator creates CDS dynamic external entities based on a given CSN model. This kind of external entity does not specify a logical external schema in its data definition, but uses the addition PROVIDED AT RUNTIME. Dynamic external entities can only be accessed using ABAP SQL.

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The ABAP CDS consumption model makes it possible to access data from external database systems within the AS ABAP using ABAP CDS. The external systems can be other SAP HANA or non-SAP HANA database systems, or a remote AS ABAP.

It is defined via the CDS external entities with static access. That means these external entities can be consumed from ABAP CDS or ABAP SQL by providing a logical external schema in the generation wizard already

This Generator Wizard creates CDS static external entities based on a given CSN model,that originates from the remote system and has been imported into ABAP backend system (and is available as CSN Model Workbench Object).

atom:entry.atom:summary:
This generator creates Artifacts needed for Commenting in Analytics. This generator is applicable for CDS View Entities which are analytical providers. These are view entities which have the header annotation Analytics.DataCategory: #CUBE or #DIMENSION. For all other views/view entities the generator results in an error. You need to enter a class in the Input field 'Document Class' which implements the Interface 'IF_RSDOC_SERVICE_VIRT'

The following objects are generated:

  • Document DDIC Table
  • Document CDS View Entity on top of the Document DDIC table

    • After generation of the Document CDS View you need to follow the below steps:

  • You need to define an association to the Document View in the Analytical Provider View.
  • You need to annotate this association with the annotation @Analytics.association.toDocumentStorage: true'

    • If you want to use the commenting feature in your Analytical Queries then you need to expose the association defined in Analytical Provider View in the Analytical Projection View ( Projection View with provider Contract Analytical Query ). If the Analytical provider has associations to Multiple Document Stores then all the associations could be exposed in Analytical Projection View and the annotation @Analytics.document.defaultAssociationToStorage:'_document_store_assoc' could be used to define the Default Document Store for that Analytical Projection View. Here '_document_store_assoc' stands for one of the associations to one of the Document View in the Analytical Provider
atom:entry.atom:title: Analytics Document Store Generator

atom:entry.atom:summary:
This generator creates one or more end to end extension fields to the selected RAP business object. All extensions, from the database table append to the CDS extend that enhances the service layer, are generated automatically.

The field names, the technical and semantic type as well as the extension names can be adjusted.

The following object types will be created:

  • Append Structures
  • CDS Extends

    • Application Component: BC-SRV-APS-EXT-FLD
atom:entry.atom:title: Extension Fields

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The InA Service generator wizard will create all ABAP development objects that are needed to build and expose an analytical query as an InA service so that it can be consumed externally, e.g., in SAP Analytics Cloud.

Starting point of the generator will be an existing analytical cube view or analytical query. In case the cube is used as a starting point, the wizard will generate a default query as a "walking skeleton" that can be enhanced by the developer e.g. by adding additional fields or calculations. On top of the query, all artefacts are generated that are needed to exposethe analytical query via an InA service.

The following development objects will be generated:

  • Analytical Query (acts as initial/default query that can be enhanced)
  • Service Definition
  • Service Binding
  • IAM App
atom:entry.atom:title: InA Service Exposure

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The Multidimensional Analysis App generator wizard will create all ABAP development objects that are needed to build, expose and deploy a Multidimensional Analysis Fiori Application.

Starting point of the generator will be an existing analytical cube view or analytical query. In case the cube is used as a starting point, the wizard will generate a default query as a "walking skeleton" that can be enhanced by the developer e.g. by adding additional fields or calculations. On top of the query, all artifacts are generated that are needed to expose the analytical query as native Fiori application to end users.

The following development objects will be generated:

  • Analytical Query (acts as initial/default query that can be enhanced)
  • Service Definition
  • Service Binding
  • App Descriptor Item
  • SAPUI5 Component
  • IAM App
atom:entry.atom:title: Multidimensional Analysis App

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The Review Booklet App generator wizard will create all ABAP development objects that are needed to build, expose and deploy a Review Booklet Fiori Application. Starting point of the generator will be an existing (analytical) Service Binding (of Type InA UI).

The wizard will generate a default Review Booklet configuration as a "walking skeleton" that can be enhanced by the developer e.g. by redefining the set of used queries as well as the layout. Using the Review Booklet Configuration, all additional artefacts are generated that are needed to expose it as Review Booklet Fiori application to end users.

Based on the service, the following development objects will be generated:

  • Review Booklet Configuration (RVBC)
  • App Descriptor Item
  • SAPUI5 Component
  • IAM App
atom:entry.atom:title: Review Booklet App Generator Wizard

atom:entry.atom:summary:
The Star Schema Generator Wizard streamlines the creation of star schema models using ABAP Core Data Services. It empowers both customers and internal ABAP developers to build comprehensive analytical models with ease. This tool guides users through the entire generation process, ensuring a consistent and efficient workflow. The wizard supports the following key components:

  • Transactional Scenario: Begin with an existing CDS view entity that captures your transactional data.
  • Analytical Cube: The core model that consolidates data for ready in-depth analysis.
  • Dimension Views: Seamlessly attach pre-existing dimension views to enrich the analytical model.

    • With just a few clicks, users can generate a star schema perfectly tailored to their reporting needs.
atom:entry.atom:title: Star Schema

atom:entry.atom:summary:
This generator creates all the repository objects that are relevant for a business object and for a RAP service.The end result is a full-blown RAP UI Service.An OData UI service makes it possible to consume a RAP service with a Fiori Elements UI or other UI clients. It creates all UI-specific information that is annotated in the RAP artifacts in the OData service metadata. A UI service can be previewed with the Fiori Elements App preview in the service binding artifact.Specifically, the following repository objects are created:
  • SAP object node type
  • SAP object type
  • Service binding
  • Service definition
  • Access control
  • RAP projection behavior definition
  • RAP behavior definition
  • Data definition for CDS projection view entity
  • Data definition for CDS view entity
  • Metadata extension
  • Database table for draft table
  • ABAP class for ABAP behavior pool
atom:entry.atom:title: OData UI Service
